Singapore politician Pritam Singh struck off as lawyer

Workers' Party chief Pritam Singh has been struck off the rolls as a lawyer by the Court of Three Judges in Singapore. The decision follows his conviction for giving false evidence under oath. The Law Society of Singapore had initiated disciplinary action. Chief Justice Sundaresh Menon stated that the offences involved dishonesty and did not meet the threshold for an exception to being struck off.
